volume: 第六卷閨風部 Volume 6: Courtesan Style Department

stories.text: 一佳人新嫁，合歡之夜，佳人以對挑之曰：「君乃讀書之輩，奴出一對，請君對之。如答得來，方許雲雨，不然則不從也。」新郎曰：「願聞。」女曰：「柳色黃金嫩，梨花白雪香，你愛不愛？」新郎對曰：「洞裡乾坤大，壺中日月長，你怕不怕？」
stories.translation: A beautiful woman had just married, and on the night of their wedding celebration, she challenged her new husband by saying, "You are a man who has studied books. I will present you with a top line of an antithetical couplet; please respond with a matching bottom line." "If you can answer it properly, I will allow us to consummate our marriage. Otherwise, I shall not comply." The newlywed husband said, "I am ready to hear it." The woman said, "Willow leaves are tender like golden yellow; pear blossoms emit a fragrant white snow. Do you love this or not?" The newlywed husband responded, "Within the cave, the universe is vast; in the gourd, days and months stretch long. Are you afraid or not?"

stories.text: 有新婦拜堂，即產下一兒，婆愧甚，急取藏之。新婦曰：「早知婆婆這等愛惜，快叫人把家中阿大、阿二都領了來罷。」
stories.translation: A newlywed bride gave birth to a son immediately after the wedding ceremony. Her mother-in-law was greatly ashamed and hurriedly took the child away and hid it. The newlywed bride said, "Had I known that Mother-in-law loves so dearly, she should quickly have someone bring all the children from home—A Da and A Er—to be taken care of."

stories.text: 有婚家女富男貧，男家慮其新婚，率領眾人搶親，誤背小姨以出。女家人急呼曰：「搶差了！」小姨在背上曰：「不差，不差！快走上些，莫信他哄你哩。」
stories.translation: In one case, a bride was wealthy while the groom's family was poor. Concerned about the wedding, the groom's side led a group of people to abduct her, mistakenly taking her younger sister instead. The bride's family quickly cried out, "You have taken the wrong one!" The younger sister on their backs said, "No mistake, no mistake!" "Hurry up and walk faster. Don't believe what they are trying to trick you with."

stories.text: 有一女擇配，適兩家並求，東家郎醜而富，西家郎美而貧。父母問其欲適誰家。女曰：「兩坦。」問其故，答曰：「我愛在東家吃飯，西家去眠。」
stories.translation: A woman was choosing a husband, and two families proposed to her at the same time. The man from the eastern family was ugly but wealthy, while the man from the western family was handsome but poor. Her parents asked which family she wished to marry into. The woman said, "Both are acceptable." When asked why, she replied, "I love to eat meals at the eastern family's home and sleep at the western family's."

stories.text: 夫勸新婦解衣。婦曰：「母戒我勿解，母命不可違；夫勸我解，夫命又不可違。奈何？」正沉吟間，夫迫之，婦曰：「我知之矣！只脫去下截，做個兩盡其情罷。」
stories.translation: The husband persuaded his newlywed wife to undress. The wife said, "My mother warned me not to take off my clothes; a daughter cannot disobey her mother's command. My husband is urging me to undress; a wife also cannot disobey her husband's order." "What should I do?" While hesitating, the husband pressed her. The wife said, "I know what to do!" "Just take off the lower part and satisfy both sides completely."

stories.text: 一女未嫁者，私問其嫂曰：「此事頗樂否？」嫂曰：「有甚樂處，只為周公之禮，制定夫婦耳。」及女出嫁後歸寧，一見其嫂，即笑罵曰：「好個說謊精。」
stories.translation: An unmarried girl privately asked her sister-in-law, "Is this matter quite pleasant?" The sister-in-law said, "What pleasure is there? It's only because of the Zhou Gong's rites that husband and wife are bound together." After the girl was married and returned home to visit, as soon as she saw her sister-in-law, she laughed and scolded, "What a lying little thing you are."

stories.text: 一妓倚門而立，見有客過，拉人打釘，適對門樓上，姑嫂二人推窗見之，姑問嫂：「扯他何事？」嫂曰：「要他行房。」須臾事畢，妓取厘戥夾剪付之，姑曰：「彼欲何為？」嫂曰：「行過了房，要他出銀子。」姑嘆曰：「好沒良心，如何反要他出。」
stories.translation: A courtesan stood by the door. When she saw a customer passing by, she pulled someone to nail something in place. Just across the street on the opposite building, an aunt and her niece looked out of the window and saw this scene. The aunt asked her sister-in-law, "Why are you pulling him?" The sister-in-law replied, "I want him to have sex with me." After a short while the matter was done. The courtesan took out a pair of small scissors and gave them to him. The aunt asked, "What does he want to do?" The sister-in-law said, "After having sex with her, I wanted him to pay silver." The aunt sighed and said, "How heartless! How could you instead demand money from him?"

stories.text: 一新婦初夜，新郎不甚在行，將陽物放進而不動。女呻吟曰：「哎喲，不好，脹痛！」夫曰：「拿出罷？」女又呻吟曰：「哎喲，不好，空痛！」夫曰：「進又脹痛，出又空痛，汝欲怎麼？」女曰：「你且拿進拿出間看。」
stories.translation: On the first night of her marriage, a newlywed bride found that her husband was not very experienced. He inserted his penis but did not move at all. The woman groaned and said, "Ah, it's bad! It hurts so much!" The husband asked, "Shall I take it out?" The woman groaned again and said, "Ah, it's bad! Now it hurts in vain!" The husband said, "Going in causes a bloated pain, and taking it out causes an empty pain. What do you want me to do?" The woman said, "Just keep putting it in and taking it out for a while."

stories.text: 一女初嫁，哭問嫂曰：「此禮何人所制？」嫂曰：「周公。」女將周公大罵不已。及滿月歸寧，問嫂曰：「周公何在？」嫂云：「他是古人，尋他做甚？」女曰：「我要製雙鞋謝他。」
stories.translation: An unmarried girl, on her first wedding day, cried and asked her sister-in-law, "Whose custom is this?" The sister-in-law replied, "Master Zhou Gong." The girl continued to curse Master Zhou Gong fiercely. After the month-long visit home, she asked her sister-in-law again, "Where is Master Zhou Gong?" The sister-in-law said, "He was an ancient person. Why are you looking for him?" The woman replied, "I want to make a pair of shoes to thank him."

stories.text: 新人初夜上床，使性不止。喜娘隔壁勸曰：「此乃人倫大事，個個如此，不要害羞。」新人曰：「你不曉得，褲子衣帶，偏生今夜打了死結。」
stories.translation: On the newlyweds' first night together, the bride could not stop expressing her desires. The matchmaker from next door advised, "This is a great matter of human relationships; everyone does it like this. There's no need to be shy." The newlywed replied, "You don't know; the belt of my pants just happened to tie a dead knot tonight."

stories.text: 一女初嫁，次早新郎背立，女扳其嘴，連親數下，郎大怒曰：「如何不識羞恥？」婦應曰：「其實一時認錯了，不知是你，莫怪，莫怪。」
stories.translation: An unmarried girl had just been married. The next morning, the groom stood with his back to her. She turned his face and kissed him several times. The groom became very angry and said, "How shameless can you be?" The wife replied, "Actually, I mistakenly recognized someone else at first and didn't realize it was you. Please don't be angry. Forgive me."

stories.text: 一女未嫁，父母索重聘。既嫁初夜，婿怪岳家爭論財禮，因恨曰：「汝父母直恁無情，我只拿你出氣。」乃大幹一次。少傾又曰：「汝兄嫂亦甚可惡，也把你來發泄。」又狠弄一番。兩度之後，精力疲倦，不覺睡去。女復搖醒曰：「我那兄弟雖小，日常多嘴多舌，倒是極蠻憊的。」
stories.translation: An unmarried girl's parents demanded a heavy dowry. On the first night after her marriage, the bridegroom was upset about the in-laws' argument over dowry and resented it. He said angrily, "Your parents are so heartless. I will just take out my anger on you." He then had vigorous sex with her. After a while, he said again, "Your brother and sister-in-law are also very annoying; I will vent my anger on you as well." He then roughly had sex with her once more. After two rounds, his energy was exhausted and he fell asleep unconsciously. The woman then shook him awake and said, "My younger brother is small in stature but often talks too much. He's actually very annoying."

stories.text: 一女與人通姦，父母知而責之。女子賴說：「都是那天殺的強姦我，非我本意。」父母曰：「你緣何不叫喊起來？」女曰：「我的娘呀，喊是要喊。你想那時，我的舌頭，被他噙緊在口裡，叫我如何喊得出。」
stories.translation: A woman committed adultery with another man. Her parents found out and scolded her. The girl denied it, saying, "It was all that damned man who raped me; it wasn't my intention." Her parents asked, "Why didn't you shout for help?" The woman said, "Oh my dear mother, I did want to shout." "You can imagine at that time, my tongue was tightly held in his mouth. How could I possibly scream?"

stories.text: 有女嫁於異鄉，歸寧，母問：「風土相同否？」答曰：「別事都一樣，只有用枕不同。吾鄉把來墊頭，彼處墊在腰下的。」
stories.translation: A woman had married to a distant place. When she returned home for a visit, her mother asked, "Is the local custom similar there?" She replied, "Everything else is the same, but only the use of pillows differs." "In our hometown, we place it under the head; there, they put it under the waist."

stories.text: 新人初夜，郎以手摸其頭而甚得意，摸其乳腹俱歡喜，及摸下體，不見兩足，驚駭問之，則已掮起半日矣。
stories.translation: On the newlyweds' first night, the husband fondled her head and was very pleased. He then touched her breasts and belly, both of which brought joy. When he reached down below and did not see her two feet, he was startled and asked about it. It turned out she had been lifting them up for half a day already.

stories.text: 幼女出嫁，喜娘歸。主母問：「姑娘連日動靜何如？」答曰：「頭夜聽得姑娘哭，想是面生害怕。第二晚不想官人哭。」母駭問：「為何？」云：「姑娘扳痛了屁股。第三夜隨嫁丫頭又大哭。」母曰：「更奇怪。」喜娘曰：「我曾問來，他說這樣一個好姑娘，口口聲聲只叫要死。」
stories.translation: A young girl was married off, and the matchmaker returned. The mother-in-law asked, "How has my daughter-in-law been these past few days?" She replied, "On the first night I heard her crying; it must be because she was shy and afraid." "On the second night, it was not my daughter-in-law who cried." The mother-in-law inquired in alarm, "Why?" She said, "My daughter-in-law hurt his bottom." "On the third night, even the maid who came with her cried loudly." The mother-in-law said, "That is even more strange." The matchmaker said, "I once asked and was told that he kept shouting in agony over such a fine girl."

stories.text: 新婚夜，送親席散。次日，廚司撿點桌面，不見一頂糖人，各處查問。新人忽大笑不止，喜娘在傍問：「笑甚麼？」女答曰：「怪不得昨夜一個人舌頭是甜津津的。」
stories.translation: On the night of their wedding, after the farewell banquet for the bride had ended. The next day, when the kitchen staff checked the table settings, they found one sugar figurine missing and began searching everywhere. Suddenly, the newlywed bride burst into uncontrollable laughter. The matchmaker beside her asked, "What are you laughing at?" The woman replied, "No wonder his tongue was so sweet last night."

stories.text: 一夫婦新婚，睡至晌午不起。母嫌其貪睡，遣婢潛往探之。婢覆曰：「官人、娘子，大家才起得一半了。」母問何故，婢曰：「官人起了上半身，娘子只起得下半身著哩。」
stories.translation: A newlywed couple had been sleeping until noon and did not get up. The mother-in-law disapproved of their laziness and sent a maid to secretly check on them. The maid reported, "Master and Madam are only halfway up." When the mother-in-law asked why, the maid replied, "Master has risen with his upper body, while Madam is only lifting her lower half."

stories.text: 一女出嫁坐床，掌禮撤帳云：「撤帳東，官人屪子好撞鐘。」女忙接口云：「弗怕。」喜嬪曰：「新娘子不宜如此口快。」新婦曰：「不是我也不說，才得進門，可惡他就把這大話來嚇我。」
stories.translation: A newlywed bride sat on the marriage bed. The master of ceremonies removed the canopy and said, "Removing the eastern side of the canopy—Master's penis is ready to strike the bell." The bride quickly added, "Don't be afraid." The matchmaker said, "A newlywed bride should not speak so bluntly." The new bride replied, "I wouldn't say it if I weren't provoked. Just after entering the door, he used such big talk to scare me."

stories.text: 新婦出嫁，坐床撤帳，掌禮念云：「夫婦雙雙喜氣揚，官人屪子硬如槍。」伴送婆應曰：「忒硬過了！」新婦接口曰：「弗要說，正好。」
stories.translation: When the newlywed bride sat on her marriage bed and the canopy was removed, the master of ceremonies recited, "The husband and wife both radiate joy; Master's penis is as hard as a spear." An accompanying aunt replied, "It's too hard!" The new bride added quickly, "Don't mention it—it's just right."

stories.text: 一母生一子一女，而女尤鍾愛。及遣嫁後，思念不已。謂子曰：「人家再不要養女兒，養得這般長成，就如被餓鷹輕輕一爪便抓去了。」子曰：「阿姆阿姆，他們如今正在那裏啄著哩。」
stories.translation: A mother gave birth to a son and a daughter, but she especially loved the daughter. After sending her off in marriage, the mother could not stop missing her. She said to her son, "No one should raise a daughter. Once they grow up, it's as if a hungry hawk pecks at them lightly and carries them away." The son replied, "Mother, Mother, they are pecking there right now."

stories.text: 有寡婦嫁人而索重聘。媒曰：「再醮與初婚不同，誰肯出次高價。」婦曰：「我還是處子，未曾破身。」媒曰：「眼見嫁過人，今做孤孀，那個肯信？」婦曰：「實不相瞞，先夫陽具渺小，故外面半截，雖則重婚，裡邊其實是個處子。」
stories.translation: A widow married and demanded an exorbitant dowry. The matchmaker said, "Remarriage is different from a first marriage—who would pay such a high price?" The woman replied, "I am still a maiden and have never lost my virginity." The matchmaker said, "Everyone can see you were married before and are now a widow—who would believe that?" The woman said, "I won't lie to you. My late husband had a very small penis, so only half of it reached inside. Though I am remarried on the outside, in reality, I'm still a virgin inside."

stories.text: 一婦晝寢不醒，一人戲將茄子納入牝中而去。婦覺，見茄在內，知為人所欺，乃大罵不止。鄰嫗謂曰：「其事甚醜，娘子省口些罷。」婦曰：「不是這等說，此番塞了茄兒不罵，日後冬瓜、葫蘆便一起來了。」
stories.translation: A woman was sleeping during the day and did not wake up. A man playfully inserted an eggplant into her vagina and left. When the woman awoke and found the eggplant inside, she realized she had been wronged and began cursing loudly without stopping. A neighborly old woman said to her, "This matter is very shameful; Madam should keep your mouth shut." The woman said, "It's not that simple. If I don't curse now for having an eggplant stuffed in me, later winter melons and gourds will come all at once."

stories.text: 夫妻將舉事，因礙兩子在旁，未知熟睡不曾。乃各喚一聲以試之。兩子聞而不應，知其欲為此事也。及雲雨大作，其母樂極，大呼叫死。一子忽大笑，母慚而撻之。又一子曰：「打得好，打得好，娘死了不哭，倒反笑起來。」
stories.translation: A husband and wife were about to have sex, but because their two children were nearby, they did not know whether the children were asleep or not. So each of them called out once to test it. The two children heard the calls but did not respond, realizing what their parents wanted to do. When the sexual activity began in earnest, the mother was so pleased that she shouted with great excitement. One of the children suddenly burst into laughter, and the mother became embarrassed and beat him. The other child said, "Beat well, beat well! Mother didn't cry when she died, but instead laughed out loud."

stories.text: 夫婦乘子熟睡，任意交感。事畢，問其妻「爽利麼？」連問數語，妻礙口不答。子在腳後云：「娘快些說了罷，我已凍殺在這裡了。」
stories.translation: While their child was sound asleep, the husband and wife indulged in sexual activity. After they were done, he asked his wife, "Was it satisfying?" He repeated the question several times, but the wife was embarrassed and did not answer. The child behind them said, "Mother, just say it quickly—I've already been frozen to death here."

stories.text: 姑嫂二人紡織，偶見蘿蔔一籃，姑曰：「藍中蘿蔔，變成男子陽物，便好。」嫂曰：「軟的更妙。」姑曰：「為何倒要軟的？」嫂曰：「軟的硬起來，一籃便是兩藍。」
stories.translation: An aunt and her niece were spinning cloth when they happened to see a basket of radishes. The aunt said, "If these radishes in the basket could turn into a man's penis, that would be nice." The niece replied, "Softer ones would be even better." The aunt asked, "Why do you want the soft ones?" The niece replied, "When a soft one gets hard, one basket becomes two baskets."

stories.text: 妻好雲雨，每怪其夫好睡，伺夫合眼，即翻身以擾之。夫問：「何以不睡？」曰：「虼蚤叮人故耳。」夫會其意，旋與之交。妻願既遂，乃安眠至曉。夫執其物而嘆曰：「我與他相處─生，竟不知他有這種本事。」妻曰：「甚麼本事？」夫曰：「會捉虼蚤。」
stories.translation: The wife enjoyed sex and often complained that her husband liked to sleep. Whenever she noticed him closing his eyes, she would turn over to disturb him. The husband asked, "Why don't you sleep?" She replied, "Because lice are biting me." Understanding her intention, the husband soon had sex with her. With her desire fulfilled, the wife slept peacefully until dawn. The husband held his penis and sighed, saying, "I have lived with her all my life and never knew she had such a talent." The wife asked, "What kind of talent?" The husband replied, "She can catch lice."

stories.text: 賊至臥室，見一婢裸體熟睡，即與交合。婢大叫「有賊」，賊狠幹不歇。婢遂低聲悄問曰：「賊哥，你幾時來的？」
stories.translation: A thief entered the bedroom, saw a maid sleeping naked, and had sex with her immediately. The maid screamed, "There's a thief!" but the thief kept having rough sex without stopping. The maid then whispered softly and asked, "Thief brother, when did you come?"

stories.text: 貧人正與妻合，妻云：「飯米都沒了，有甚高興？」夫物頓痿。妻復云：「雖如此說，壇內收拾起來，還夠明後日吃哩。」
stories.translation: A poor man was having sex with his wife when she said, "There's no rice left. What is there to be happy about?" The husband's penis immediately became flaccid. The wife then added, "Even so, if we clean up the rice in the jar, it will still be enough for tomorrow and the day after."

stories.text: 開腐店者，夫婦雲雨，妻嫌其物渺小。夫潛往外，取研石膏擂棰，暗暗塞進。妻曰：「你在那裡吃了什麼來，此物頓然大了！天氣和暖，為何凍得他恁冰冷？」
stories.translation: A man who ran a tofu shop had sex with his wife, but the wife complained that his penis was too small. The husband secretly went outside, took a pestle used for grinding plaster of Paris, and quietly inserted it inside. The wife said, "What did you eat out there? This thing suddenly got so big!" "The weather is warm and pleasant—why has it made him so cold?"

stories.text: 一婦臨產，腹中痛甚，乃咎其夫曰：「都是你作怪，帶累我如此。」怨詈不止。夫呵之曰：「娘子，省得你埋怨，總是此物不好，莫若閹割了，絕此禍根！」遂持刀欲割。妻大呼曰：「活冤家！我痛得死去還魂，這刻才好些，你又來催命了。」
stories.translation: A woman was about to give birth and suffered severe abdominal pain. She blamed her husband, saying, "It's all your fault that I'm suffering like this." She continued cursing in anger without stopping. The husband scolded her, saying, "Madam, to avoid your complaints in the future, this thing is just no good. Why not castrate it and eliminate this source of trouble?" He then took out a knife and wanted to cut it off. The wife shouted, "My living enemy!" "I was in so much pain I almost died and just now started to feel a bit better. Now you come to kill me again!"

stories.text: 一婦臨產創甚，與夫誓曰：「以後不許近身，寧可一世無兒，再不幹那營生矣。」夫曰：「謹依尊命。」及生一女，夫妻相議命名，妻曰：「喚做招弟罷。」
stories.translation: A woman in severe labor pain vowed to her husband, "From now on, you are not allowed to come near me. I would rather have no children for the rest of my life than go through that again." The husband said, "I will follow your command." When they had a daughter, the couple discussed naming her. The wife said, "Let's call her Zhaodi."

stories.text: 一婦生育甚難，因咎丈夫曰：「皆你平素作孽，害我今日受苦。」夫甚不過意，遂相戒：「從今各自分床，不可再幹此事。」妻然之。彌月後，夜間忽聞啟戶聲。夫問：「是誰？」妻應曰：「那個不怕死的又來了。」
stories.translation: A woman had a very difficult childbirth and blamed her husband, saying, "It's all because of your past misdeeds that I suffer so much today." The husband felt very guilty and vowed, "From now on we should sleep in separate beds. We must never do that again." The wife agreed. A month later, at night she suddenly heard the sound of a door opening. The husband asked, "Who is it?" The wife replied, "That one who isn't afraid of death has come again."

stories.text: 一貧家生子極多，艱於衣食。夫咎妻曰：「多男多累，誰教你多男？」妻曰：「寡慾多子，誰教你寡慾！」
stories.translation: A poor family had many children and struggled with clothing and food. The husband blamed his wife, saying, "Too many sons bring too much trouble—who taught you to have so many?" The wife replied, "Abstaining from desire leads to more children—who taught you to abstain from desire!"

stories.text: 一人連舉數子，醫士諛之曰：「寡欲多男子。兄少年老成，過於保養之故。何不乘此強壯，快活快活。」妻在屏後應曰：「先生說得極是。我也生育得不耐煩，覺得苦極了。」
stories.translation: A man had several children in succession. A doctor flattered him, saying, "Abstaining from desire produces many sons." "Your elder brother is mature for his age because he takes excessive care of himself." "Why not take advantage of this strength and enjoy yourself a bit?" The wife, behind the screen, replied, "You are absolutely right, sir." "I've had enough of giving birth and find it extremely painful."

stories.text: 一人從外歸，私問兒曰：「母親曾往何處去來？」答曰：「間壁。」問：「做何事？」兒曰：「想是同外公吃蟹。」又問：「何以知之？」兒曰：「只聽見說：『拍開來，縮縮腳。』娘又叫道：『勿要慌，我個親爺。』」
stories.translation: A man returned from outside and secretly asked his son, "Where has your mother gone?" The boy replied, "To the neighbor's house." Asked, "What did she do there?" The child said, "Probably had crab with Grandpa." He asked again, "How do you know that?" The child said, "I just heard them say: 'Crack it open and pull back the legs.'" "My mother also called out, 'Don't be in a hurry, my dear father.'"

stories.text: 一人痿陽，具牲禮禱神。巫者祝曰：「世陽世陽，顧得卵硬如槍。」病者曰：「何敢望此？」妻從屏後呼曰：「費了大錢大陌，也得如此！」
stories.translation: A man with impotence prepared sacrificial offerings and prayed to the gods. The shaman chanted, "Shiyang Shiyang, make it hard as a spear." The patient said, "How dare I hope for such a thing?" His wife called out from behind the screen, "We've spent so much money; it has to be like this!"

stories.text: 一人欲事過度，憊甚，夫婦相約：「下次雲雨，止放半截。」及行事，妻掬夫腰盡納之。夫責以前約，妻曰：「我原講過是下半截。」
stories.translation: A man was overly indulgent in sexual activity and became very exhausted. The couple made an agreement: "Next time we make love, only do half of it." When the time came, the wife pulled her husband's waist completely in. The man scolded his wife for breaking their previous agreement. The wife said, "I originally meant the lower half."

stories.text: 婦人見男子鼻大，戲之曰：「你鼻大物也大。」男子見婦人嘴小，亦戲曰：「你嘴小陰亦小。」兩人興動，遂為雲雨。不意男之物甚細，而女之陰甚大，婦曰：「原來你的鼻不準。」男曰：「原來你的嘴也不準。」
stories.translation: A woman saw a man with a big nose and teased him, saying, "Your nose is big, so your member must be big too." The man saw the woman had a small mouth and teased her as well, saying, "Your mouth is small, so your vagina must be small too." Stimulated by their teasing, the two became intimate. Unexpectedly, the man's member was very small while the woman's vagina was quite large. The woman said, "So your nose isn't accurate after all." stories.text: 有婦訴官云：「往井間汲水，被人從後淫污。」官曰：「汝那時何不立起？」答曰：「若立起，恐脫了出來耳。」
stories.translation: A woman filed a lawsuit with the authorities, saying, "While I was drawing water from the well, someone from behind defiled me." The official asked, "Why didn't you stand up at that time?" She replied, "If I had stood up, it might have slipped out."

stories.text: 婦握夫兩卵，問是何物。夫曰：「栗子。」夫亦指妻牝戶，問是何物。妻曰：「火爐。既是你有栗子，何不放在爐內，煨他一煨？」夫曰：「可。」少頃，婦撒一屁，兒在傍叫曰：「爹爹，栗子熟矣，在爐內爆響了！」
stories.translation: A woman held her husband's testicles and asked what they were. The husband said, "Chestnuts." 藟 The husband also pointed to his wife's vagina and asked what it was. The wife said, "A stove." "If you have chestnuts, why not put them in the stove and roast them a bit?" The husband said, "Okay." After a short while, the wife let out a fart. stories.text: 夫婦同飯，妻問曰：「韭蒜有何好處，汝喜吃他？」夫曰：「食之，此物如鐵棒一般的。」妻亦連食不已，夫曰：「汝吃何用？」妻曰：「我吃了像鐵箍一般的。」
stories.translation: A husband and wife were eating together. The wife asked, "What good are leeks and garlic? Why do you like to eat them?" The husband said, "When I eat this, it feels as hard as an iron rod." The wife kept eating continuously. The husband asked, "What do you need to eat for?" The wife said, "After I eat it, it feels like an iron cuff."

stories.text: 一人遇兩來船，手托在窗檻外，夾傷一指。歸訴於妻，妻駭然囑曰：「今後遇兩來船，切記不可解小便。」
stories.translation: A man encountered two boats coming toward him. He held his hand out the window sill, and one of his fingers was pinched and injured. He returned home and complained to his wife, who was startled and warned him, "In the future, when you encounter two boats coming toward you, remember not to urinate."

stories.title_en: Having Sex While Drunk and Full

stories.translation: A man liked to seek sexual pleasure after drinking alcohol. Someone warned him, "Do not have sex when drunk and full; your five internal organs will be turned upside down. This is a medical warning—how could you ignore it?" The man said, "It's fine." After having sex once, he did it again. He turned around as before and claimed nothing had changed.

stories.translation: loyd A woman had an immoral lifestyle. Every time she married a husband, she would have an affair and was sent away as soon as her husband discovered it. Within three years, she went through ten husbands in succession. Someone asked her, "Why have you become so unfortunate?" The woman said, "It's because I was born with bad fate. Whoever marries me has to be a cuckold."

stories.text: 一婦訴其夫曰：「鄰某常常看我。」夫曰：「睬他做甚？」婦曰：「我今日對你說，你不在意，下次被他看上了，卻不關我事。」
stories.translation: A woman complained to her husband, "Neighbor Mr. X often watches me." The husband said, "Why do you pay attention to him?" The woman said, "I'm telling you today. If you don't care now, next time if he looks at me and something happens, it won't be my fault."

stories.text: 妻令夫買絲瓜，夫立門外候之，有賣韭者至，勸之使買。夫曰：「要買絲瓜耳。」賣者曰：「絲瓜痿陽，韭菜興陽，如何興陽的不買，倒去買痿陽的？」妻聞之，高聲喚曰：「絲瓜等不來，就買了韭菜罷。」
stories.translation: The wife told her husband to buy sponge gourds. The husband waited outside the door, and when a leek vendor arrived, he advised him to make a purchase instead. The husband said, "I need to buy sponge gourds." The vendor said, "Sponge gourds cause impotence, while leeks stimulate virility. Why don't you buy the ones that enhance virility and instead go for the ones that cause impotence?" Hearing this, the wife shouted loudly, "The sponge gourds aren't coming, so just buy some leeks instead."

stories.text: 有客方飯，偶談「絲瓜痿陽，不如韭菜興陽」。已而主人呼酒不至，以問兒，兒曰：「娘往園裡去了。」問：「何為？」答曰：「拔去絲瓜種韭菜。」
stories.translation: A guest was having a meal when he casually mentioned, "Sponge gourds weaken virility; leeks are better at stimulating it." Soon after, the host called for wine but no one came. He asked his son where they were, and the boy replied, "Mother went to the garden." The father asked, "What is she doing?" The boy answered, "She's pulling out the sponge gourds and planting leeks."

stories.text: 夫妻反目，分頭而睡。夜半，妻欲動而難以啟口，乃摸夫腳問曰：「這是甚物？」夫曰：「腳。」妻曰：「既是腳，可放在腳淘裡去。」
stories.translation: The husband and wife had a quarrel and slept separately. In the middle of the night, the wife wanted to make a move but found it difficult to speak up, so she touched her husband's foot and asked, "What is this?" The husband said, "A foot." The wife said, "If it's a foot, you can put it in the foot basin."

stories.text: 幼女見兩狗相牽，問母曰：「好好兩隻狗，為何聯攏在一處？」母曰：「想是怕冷。」女搖頭曰：「不是，不是。」母曰：「怎見得不是？」女曰：「前日大熱天氣，你和爹爹也是這樣，難道都是怕冷不成？」
stories.translation: A young girl saw two dogs tied together and asked her mother, "These are such good dogs. Why are they tied together?" The mother said, "Probably because they're afraid of the cold." The girl shook her head and said, "No, no." The mother asked, "How do you know it's not?" The girl said, "The other day on a hot day, you and Father were like this too. Could it be that they're all afraid of the cold?"

stories.title_en: Ensuring the Birth of a Son
stories.text: 問：「如何方穩生男？」給之者曰：「連二卵納入，無不成胎矣。」夜則如其言，納左則右出，納右則左復出。恚曰：「便生出兒子來，也是個強種！」
stories.translation: Asked, "How can one ensure giving birth to a son?" The person answering said, "Insert two of them at once, and you will surely conceive." That night, she followed the advice. When inserting on the left, it came out from the right; when inserting on the right, it came back out from the left. In anger, she said, "Even if a son is born this way, he will be a stubborn child!"

stories.text: 夫狎龍陽歸，妻輒作嘔吐狀，謂其滿身屎臭，不容近身。至夜同宿，夫故離開以試之。妻漸次捱近，久之，遂以牝戶靠陽，將有湊合之意。夫曰：「此物齷齪，近之何為？」妻曰：「正為齷齪，要把陰水洗他一洗。」

stories.text: ─人衣軟，令其妻漿硬些。妻用漿漿好，隨扯夫陽具，也漿一漿。夫駭問，答曰：「漿漿硬好用。」

stories.text: 婦謂夫曰：「腳盆內潮浴，還是腳盆好過，浴的好過？」夫曰：「消息子取耳，還是耳好過，消息好過？」語畢，雲雨。鄰人問曰：「消息落在腳盆裡，那個好過？」

stories.text: 兩夫婦度歲，夫於除夕戒妻曰：「往日行房，每到快活處，必定叫死。明日是新年，大家忌說死字，但說我要活。」妻然之。及次日行房，妻樂極，仍叫如前。夫怪其忌犯，妻曰：「不妨。像這種死法，那怕一年死到頭！」

stories.text: 有再醮者，初夜交合，進而不覺也。問夫：「進去否？」曰：「進去矣。」婦遂顰蹩曰：「如此，我有些疼。」

stories.translation: After her husband died, the wife kept fanning his body with a fan without stopping. A neighbor asked, "It's cold outside—why do this?" The wife wiped her tears and replied, "My late husband gave me final instructions before he died: 'If you want to remarry, you must wait until my flesh is cold.'"

stories.text: 兩婦對門而居，甲問乙曰：「生過幾胎了？」乙曰：「未曾破體。」甲曰：「難道你家大爺是不的麼？」乙搖頭曰：「不，不。」
stories.translation: Two women lived across from each other. Woman A asked woman B, "How many children have you given birth to?" Woman B said, "I've never had a child." Woman A said, "Does that mean your husband is not one?" Woman B shook her head and said, "No, no."

The husband actually loved the concubine, but he scolded her saying, "It would be better to kill you so I don't have to deal with your mischief." The concubine ran into the room. stories.title_en: "His is big; mine is also big."
stories.text: 一家娶妾，年紀過長於妻。有賣婆見禮，問：「那位是大？」妾應云：「大是他大，大是我大。」
stories.translation: A family took a concubine who was older than the wife. An old woman selling something paid respects and asked, "Which one is the elder?" The concubine replied, "His is big; mine is big."

stories.text: 一人欲往妾處，詐稱：「我要出恭，去去就來。」妻不許，夫即賭咒云：「若他往做狗。」妻將索繫其足放去。夫解索，轉縛狗腳上，竟往妾房。妻見去久不至，收索到床邊，起摸著狗背，乃大駭云：「這死烏龜，我還道是騙我，卻原來倒罰了真咒。」

The wife refused, so the husband immediately took an oath and said, "If he goes there, let him become a dog." The wife tied a rope to his foot and let him go. The wife, seeing that he had been gone for a long time and not returned, retrieved the rope to the bedside. She got up and touched the dog's back, then exclaimed in great alarm, "This dead turtle! I thought you were tricking me, but it turns out you actually cast a real curse!"

stories.text: 人家有一妻一妾，前後半夜分認。上半夜至妻房，妻騰身跨上夫肚行事，夫問：「何為？」曰：「此倒澆蠟燭也。」其妾早在門外竊聞之矣。下半夜乃同妾睡，恣意歡娛，妾快甚，不覺失聲曰：「我死也！」妻亦在外潛聽之矣。次早量米造飯，妻曰：「今日當減一人飯米？」妾曰：「為何？」妻曰：「昨晚死了一個人。」妾亦微笑曰：「依我看來，今日還該添一人才是。」妻問何故，答曰：「聞得有個澆蠟燭的師父在此。」

The concubine replied, "Because I heard there is a wax candle master here."

stories.text: 一翁扒灰，事畢，揖其媳曰：「多謝娘子美情。」媳曰：「爹爹休得如此客氣，自己家裏，那裏謝得許多。」

He was well, but the other day the court officials came to arrest twelve old men for committing incest with their daughters-in-law. Your father hid in the latrine and nearly got scared to death."

The old man thought it was his daughter-in-law and praised her greatly, saying that she far surpassed the grandmother-in-law. The grandmother-in-law scolded, "Stinking old thief! You can't even recognize an old thing—what antiques are you selling!"
